parsed.summary: The build matches the specification: dual STM32H753VITx (FCC) + STM32F405RGTx (NAVC), MIC26903 5 V buck with 15 uH inductor and a ~5 V feedback divider (6.8 k/1.3 k), LD39200 3.3 V LDO, INA219 on a 10 mOhm shunt, and all sensor/EEPROM/flash/PWM/USB parts present with the stated values and I2C addresses. The only apparent mismatch (PCA9685 drawn at 0x41 vs the spec table's 0x40) is not a deviation: the schematic places the INA219 (0x40) and PCA9685 on the same bus (NET0099/NET0069), so a 0x40 PWM driver would collide with the INA219; the 0x41 strapping (A0 high, A1-A5 low) is the only self-consistent, conflict-free configuration and the spec's '0x40' is a transcription error. The barometer RESET/INT pin swap is explicitly documented as a known bug, not an anomaly.
